newsitem.title: USA: Interpublic starts sports marketing group.
newsitem.headline: Interpublic starts sports marketing group.

text.p: Interpublic Group of Cos Inc said Monday that it has acquired Advantage International, in Washington, D.C., and a majority stake in The API Group of Companies, based in London.

Both privately-held companies are sports marketing firms, and will form the basis of a new sports marketing group within Interpublic, said the company, with initial billings of around $550 million annually and revenue in excess of $50 million.
Terms of the transactions were not disclosed.
Interpublic said that Advantage and API represent over 100 blue chip international companies and work for or closely with almost every major sports federation and broadcaster in the world.
The two companies will, for the foreseeable future, retain their separate identities and be run by their current management teams, said Interpublic, but it expects to consider a full merger later on.
Interpublic operates in over 100 countries with billings of $20 billion, and includes the advertising firms of McCann Erickson Worldwide and Ammirati Puris Lintas.
